name: Nondetection

components.m: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a willing creature, or a place or object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension

summary: For 8 hours a creature, place or object can't be targeted by Divination spells or seen by scrying sensors.
text: For 8 hours, the target you touch is hidden from Divination magic. The target can be a willing creature, or a place or object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. No Divination spell can target it, and magical scrying sensors can't perceive it.
